negative_evidence: The model is explicitly phenomenological and local: it requires a non-zero reward gradient within natural movement variability and is limited to small workspace regions.
It caches one successful aim and uses local exploration; it does not learn or store a full reinforcement landscape.
The modeled intended aim is latent and fitted from behavior, not a directly measured neural state.

S2 behavioral estimates of sigma_m and sigma_e are initial guesses; S3 final bootstrap optimization frees alpha, sigma_m and sigma_e. These data/fitting artifacts do not add a new core model operator.
unresolved_issues: Model remains phenomenological/local and latent intended aim is not directly measured.
S2/S3 support fit provenance but do not independently define the mathematical model.

annotation: direct ancestors include 10.1523/JNEUROSCI.3244-14.2015 and 10.1523/ENEURO.0050-18.2018; global genealogy independence not certified

preserved_noninferences: motor target/body/environment cannot automatically become internal skill or coordinator state
training schedule cannot automatically become learning operator
fitted latent variable cannot automatically become stored memory
learned parameter cannot automatically become an additional active controller
offline/training plasticity cannot automatically become online coordinator
complexity or fit failure cannot imply A2
no genealogy path/citation is not independence
